veranderings.voor: gee vir die hout daardie eerste hitte
veranderings.na: gee die hout daardie eerste hitte
veranderings.rede: With 'gee' the indirect object reads more naturally without 'vir'; 'eerste hitte' stays intact.

veranderings.blok: Lug hou die vuur aan die gang
veranderings.voor: Jy kan self meer lug by 'n vuur bring.
veranderings.na: Jy kan self 'n vuur meer lug gee.
veranderings.rede: 'lug by 'n vuur bring' is wooden; 'n vuur meer lug gee' says the same thing naturally and keeps 'lug' for the moving air.

veranderings.blok: Hoe brande in ons gemeenskappe begin
veranderings.rede: 'Dieselfde' points back to a candle or stove falling over and setting a curtain alight, which is not what happens with food left on the stove; naming the fire keeps the meaning and fixes the reference.
